title: Trace ID propagation: web → API → service → audit
intent: Every user action in web creates a trace ID and echoes it in API response headers and JSON body, enabling link-following from UI through logs to artifacts.

201.description: API response includes X-Trace-ID header and trace_id in JSON

manual_simulation: curl -H 'X-Trace-ID: $(uuidgen)' http://localhost:3000/api/trpc/tasks.create
incentive: Enable root cause analysis and observability linkage

title: Trace ID echo in web footer, clickable copy
intent: Display current trace_id in web footer as [copy] button so user can paste it into support requests and logs.
anti_patterns: trace_id not visible anywhere in UI
manual_simulation: Open browser DevTools > Application > SessionStorage, find trace_id, verify footer shows it

title: Trace ID echo in CLI JSON output and status bar
intent: CLI JSON output includes trace_id and links fields, TUI status bar displays current trace_id.
anti_patterns: TUI status bar missing trace context
manual_simulation: fulcrum tasks list --json | jq '.trace_id'

title: Audit log entry per state transition with causation linkage
intent: Every task/run/doc/artifact state change creates audit row with actor, action, before/after, causation_id, and timestamp.

audit.description: Row has id, timestamp, actor, action, subject_kind, subject_id, causation_id fields

manual_simulation: Update task status, check database audit table, verify links back to task

title: Audit retention policy: 90 days or org-configurable TTL
intent: Audit rows older than 90 days are soft-deleted (marked with deleted_at). Org settings allow TTL override.

retention.description: Audit rows with deleted_at are not returned by audit query

manual_simulation: Set TTL to 1 day, wait or mock clock, verify rows are soft-deleted

title: Runs feed: event ordering, filtering by status/project/actor/time
intent: Runs list supports sorting by created_at DESC, filtering by status (running|succeeded|failed), project, actor, date range.
manual_simulation: Create 5 runs with different statuses, filter by status=running, verify order

title: Run worker reassignment: audit trail and coordination
intent: When a run is reassigned from one worker to another, create audit row with old_worker_id, new_worker_id, reason, causation_id.

audit.description: Run reassignment visible as audit event with actor and reason

anti_patterns: reassignment not visible in run detail
manual_simulation: Claim run as worker1, release it, claim as worker2, verify audit trail
incentive: Coordination and debugging of agent handoff

title: Generated E2E spec: generation, execution, result linking
intent: When a run completes, generate E2E spec from artifacts/transcript. Store spec with run_id and project_id. Spec is queryable from run detail.

artifact.description: E2E spec created and stored with clear run_id linkage

run.detail.description: Links to generated E2E spec visible and clickable

anti_patterns: spec generated but not linked to run
spec stored without run_id in path
manual_simulation: Complete a run, check artifacts for E2E spec, verify filename contains run_id
incentive: Enable automated testing of agent output

title: Generated E2E retry on flake: automatic rerun and result deduplication
intent: E2E spec execution failures marked as 'flake' (intermittent) trigger automatic rerun (up to 3x). Results deduplicated by spec_id.

e2e.result.description: Flaky tests rerun automatically, result shows attempt count

anti_patterns: no distinction between flake and true failure
manual_simulation: Run E2E that randomly fails, observe retries and final verdict in run detail
incentive: Reduce false negatives from E2E flakiness

title: Doctor subsystem registration and probe action discovery
intent: Doctor service discovers registered subsystems (api, db, pglite, orchest, audit, memory). Each subsystem exposes probe() function.
manual_simulation: Call doctor.subsystems, then doctor.run, verify each subsystem checked
incentive: Enable rapid health checks and triage

title: Doctor failure result: actionable recovery, not just red status
intent: When doctor.run() finds a subsystem down, return {ok: false, message, recovery_action, runnable_command}.

doctor.result.description: Failed subsystem includes recovery_action and runnable_command

anti_patterns: doctor returns {ok: false} with no guidance
manual_simulation: Simulate PGlite lock, call doctor, verify recovery_action, run suggested command

title: Telemetry: opt-in default, first-run prompt, FULCRUM_TELEMETRY env var
intent: First run after install/upgrade, prompt user about telemetry. Default is opt-out. Users can set FULCRUM_TELEMETRY=on/off.

firstrun.description: User sees telemetry prompt and can opt in/out

manual_simulation: First run after clean install, see telemetry prompt, set FULCRUM_TELEMETRY=off

title: Error log capture: stack, breadcrumbs, context, source run/task linkage
intent: When an error occurs, capture stack trace, 10 most recent breadcrumbs, execution context (run_id, task_id, project_id), timestamp.

error.log.description: Contains stack, breadcrumbs, run_id, task_id, error_id, timestamp

manual_simulation: Trigger error in run, check ~/.fulcrum/logs/errors.log, verify stack and breadcrumbs present

title: Error log link to source run and task from run detail
intent: Run detail error section links to error log entry via error_id. Error log entry includes run_id and task_id.

error.log.description: Entry includes run_id and task_id for bidirectional linkage

anti_patterns: error log not discoverable from run detail
manual_simulation: Complete run with error, view error section, click [view log], verify full context

title: Local-first PGlite cold start: schema init, seed, ready in <5s
intent: First run creates ~/.fulcrum/db/main (or FULCRUM_HOME/db/main). Schema is idempotent. Default seed creates org, user, session.

startup.description: Cold start from empty ~/.fulcrum/db completes in <5s

manual_simulation: rm -rf ~/.fulcrum && fulcrum doctor && time curl http://localhost:3000/api/health

title: Local-first PGlite warm start: existing schema and data, ready in <2s
intent: When ~/.fulcrum/db/main exists with valid schema, start time is <2s. Migrations (if any) are applied idempotently.

startup.description: Warm start with existing db completes in <2s

anti_patterns: warm start slower than cold start (regression)
manual_simulation: Start app, note time, restart, time should be <2s

title: Local-first PGlite lock recovery: auto-detect stale lock, retry with backoff
intent: If PGlite startup finds exclusive lock held by dead process, detect and recover (rm lock file + retry).

pglite.lock.description: Stale lock detected and recovered automatically or via doctor

manual_simulation: Simulate stale lock: create .lock file, start app, verify recovery or doctor fix

title: Local-first PGlite corruption detection and recovery
intent: On schema or data corruption, expose as doctor subsystem failure with recovery action 'fulcrum doctor --run-fix=pglite-rebuild'.

corruption.detect.description: Detected during startup, reported by doctor

manual_simulation: Corrupt a table manually, start app, doctor should report, fix should work

title: PostgreSQL switch via FULCRUM_DATABASE_URL environment variable
intent: If FULCRUM_DATABASE_URL is set (postgres://...), use PostgreSQL instead of PGlite. Schema migrations run idempotently.

env.FULCRUM_DATABASE_URL.description: When set to postgres://, PostgreSQL is used

manual_simulation: Set FULCRUM_DATABASE_URL=postgres://localhost/fulcrum and start app, verify it connects

title: Migrations: idempotent on re-run, no rollback required
intent: Every migration is idempotent. Running migrations twice has same result as running once (e.g., CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS).
manual_simulation: Run migrations, run again, verify no errors and same state

title: Seeded local identity: org, user, token visible on first login
intent: After first start, default org 'Local' with user 'admin@local' is visible in UI. Auth session token displayed in CLI and settings.

settings.api.description: Settings page shows org_id and user_id for API calls

anti_patterns: seed user not visible after first start
no token visible for API use
manual_simulation: Clean start, login, verify 'Local' org visible, run 'fulcrum auth show-token'

title: FULCRUM_HOME path discipline: all local state under one dir
intent: All local state (db, logs, cache, hooks, temp) lives under FULCRUM_HOME (default ~/.fulcrum).
manual_simulation: Set FULCRUM_HOME=/tmp/test_fulcrum and verify all state stored there

title: FULCRUM_FEATURES flag list: guidance and discovery
intent: FULCRUM_FEATURES env var accepts comma-separated feature flags (e.g., 'embeddings'). Unrecognized flags warn but don't block.

cli.features.description: 'fulcrum features list' shows available flags and descriptions

manual_simulation: Set FULCRUM_FEATURES=invalid,embeddings and verify warning, run 'fulcrum features list'

title: Agent-native parity: every UI action reachable via API + CLI + TUI
intent: No capability exposed only in Web. Every action (create, read, update, delete, workflow) is reachable via API endpoint, CLI command, and TUI screen.

parity.test.description: Interface parity test covers Web, CLI, TUI for key workflows

anti_patterns: feature only on API (not exposed in UI)
manual_simulation: Create task on Web, verify same action works on CLI (fulcrum tasks create) and TUI (keybinding)
